description.value:
You've learned to draft a plan and see it through. As an action, choose up to six creatures (yourself included) that you can see within 60 feet, assigning each one a category, ability check, attack roll, or saving throw. Each gains an Emergency Planning die (a d8).

Within the next 10 minutes, each creature may, once, add its Emergency Planning die to a roll of the assigned category; it can wait until after rolling the d20 to decide, but must choose before the outcome is announced. The die is spent once used, and a creature can hold only one such die at a time.

Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before using it again. The die grows to 1d10 at 13th level and 1d12 at 17th level.
